sources.title: JSON Schema Validation 2020-12
supports: Required fields, primitive types, patterns and enum

sources.title: JSON Schema Understanding: Objects
supports: Optional properties, required fields and strict extra-field policy

claims.statement: OpenAPI 3.1 response descriptions can use JSON Schema to specify a provider response representation.
claims.rationale: The normative OAS document defines response schema descriptions.

claims.statement: JSON Schema required lists describe which properties must appear in a valid object instance.
claims.rationale: The validation vocabulary describes property presence constraints.

claims.statement: An additionalProperties schema applies to names not already matched by properties in the current schema.
claims.rationale: The core specification defines how extra property validation works.

claims.statement: An optional property is absent from required, while additionalProperties false rejects unknown properties in strict object validation.
claims.rationale: The official tutorial illustrates open and closed object validation.
